## Objective

Deliver one reusable local Project app whose Home explains its selected project and leads to existing knowledge and supported project reading.

User value: A reader can understand the project, choose a useful first step and find reliable project information without commands or knowledge of internal terminology.

### Success outcomes

- The same reviewed build presents different projects using their own identity and source-linked content.
- Home and available Work, Search, Health and help remain usable when optional knowledge or memory is unavailable.
- The macOS launcher opens the correct Home and separates tab, session and owned-service controls.
- Neutral Template delivery and selected adoption preserve project content, canonical history and owner authority.
- All 31 requirements are covered by the smallest sufficient shared evidence and truthful delivery documentation.

## Scope

### In scope

- The complete REQ-001 through REQ-031 approved homepage-centered reader scope.
- Independent primary project context; stable reviewed Home content and provenance; one shared frontend and navigation.
- Thin canonical Work, knowledge/memory, lexical search, source, health/setup and tools/help read adapters.
- Existing local reading protections, macOS launch/reopen/close/stop and standalone Explorer compatibility.
- Reusable source and neutral Template distribution, selected existing-project adoption capability and proposed exact depot-root adoption.
- Minimal combined static, content, synthetic-fixture and browser verification with final traceability/preservation audit.

### Out of scope

- Any implementation, build, installation, service launch, adoption or test execution during this plan-creation operation.
- Browser authoring, Task/document mutations, agent control, collaboration content or acknowledgements, management/depot modules and new viewer permissions.
- Cross-project aggregation, unrestricted browsing, bulk adoption, existing real-product installation or widening the initializer destination boundary.
- Runtime prose/model generation, cloud services, optional backend provisioning, editors/terminals, unattended scheduling and repair loops.
- Export, new preference systems, dashboards/scores, new performance targets, framework rewrites and dependency upgrades.
- Voice/audio/speech, dedicated screen-reader/narration, certification, OS/browser matrices, stress/benchmarks, native-agent pilots, exhaustive optional/failure scenarios and the historical full-release test program.
- Git staging/commit/push, external communication, GitHub Pages/public deployment and synchronization of unrelated Task/TRD/plan/memory state.

### Execution authority

This managed plan records proposed work only. Creating, tracking or approving it does not authorize implementation, installation, dependency changes, adoption, deletion, publication, deployment or another separately governed action. Later execution must authorize the exact canonical revision and name selected destinations; the applicable Task and owner workflows retain their gates.
